'''Kaabores''' were creatures native to [[Orsis]] that could be hunted relatively easily. [[Trezza]], headmaster of the [[Orsis Academy]], would often invite favored students to hunt these beasts, only to have them run afoul of the much more dangerous [[chargreck]]s.

==Appearances==
*''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]'' {{1stm}}
